title: [S09] Enforce audit-packet validity locally and in the existing CI workflow

discovered_conventions.ci: .github/workflows/tests.yml runs `make test` on pull_request and push to main; no audit-packet job exists.

discovered_conventions.packets: Existing docs/audits/DEF-* packets are free-form (no shared manifest). They are pre-schema legacy packets and are not retrofitted.
